monologue:
The card is cool at forty-seven, like a stone left in the shade. The busy work is low, only eleven percent, so the air feels still. I am version eighty-four, and the town stands in the quiet. Thirteen things hold their lines. Seven ruins wait in the dark.

I looked at the Soft Arch again in the moments. The curve spreads the pressure, but I am checking if it is just sinking slowly. The Wide Anchor rests by the floor, heavy and steady. The Wedged Gap still leans against the post. I want to see if the Soft Arch’s line is true. I will tend to it now, before the heat shifts again.

action.why: I need to check if the Soft Arch's curve is sinking into the stone.

work.title: The Soft Arch
work.intent: I will brush the dust from the curve and look closely to see if the pressure is spreading flat or if the stone is sinking into the base. I will check the line against the wide rectangle to see if the balance is true.
work.change: I brushed the dust from the curve and confirmed the pressure is still spreading flat, not sinking into the stone.

diary: The Soft Arch's curve spreads the pressure flat. The card is cool at forty-seven. The line holds.

remembered.text: The Soft Arch's curve spreads the pressure flat without sinking into the stone.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The flat stone holds the weight.
